description:
Hankkija Finnish Feed Innovations develops unique, natural feed materials designed to support the optimal performance of farm animals. Hankkija Oy, Finland’s largest agribusiness company, is part of the farmer-owned Danish Agro Group. In 2026, Hankkija’s feed business celebrates its 100th anniversary.

What sets us apart is our global network of Research Partners, bringing together expertise in gut microbiology, animal physiology, metabolomics, nutrition, and farm production performance. Through this synergistic combination of skills, we develop innovative products that deliver measurable benefits to farmers by helping address the food production challenges of today and tomorrow.

Progut® Extra

is our unique, patented yeast hydrolysate that supports the production performance of poultry, pigs, ruminants, and aquatic species. It is produced from spent Saccharomyces yeast through a strong acid hydrolysis process that ensures the optimal release of water-soluble oligosaccharides. Following hydrolysis, the product is carefully spray-dried without removing any of the valuable yeast components. Progut® Extra contains bioavailable beta-glucans, mannan-oligosaccharides, nucleotides, and chitin.

ProHumi®

is our novel high-fiber feed material, launched in Finland in autumn 2024. It contains 100% selected, heat-treated dark peat sourced from Finland. Every production batch is rigorously analyzed to ensure the absence of microbial contaminants. ProHumi® is a dry, free-flowing powder containing approximately 71% total dietary fibre. It is particularly well suited for pig and poultry diets.

ProHumi® Farm offers the same composition and qualities as ProHumi®, but in pellet form. The pellets are relatively hard, measuring 8 mm in diameter and 1–3 cm in length. They are ideally suited as a chewable and edible enrichment material for pigs of all ages.

Progres®

In the Nordic and Baltic countries, Hankkija offers the unique, patented tall oil fatty acid product Progres®. It contains approximately 90% free fatty acids, primarily linoleic and oleic acids, as well as approximately 9% coniferous resin acids. Progres® is produced in Finland through heat distillation from a side-stream of the cellulose industry.

description: Holoruminant is a multi-actor project aiming to elucidate the role of ruminant-associated microbiomes and their interplay with the host animal in early life and throughout fundamental life events (e.g. weaning, feed transitions and lactation) that are known to affect health, welfare and environmental efficiency in ruminant production systems. HoloRuminant will use a holistic multi-omics approach to characterize the establishment and dynamics of microbiomes. In this way, HoloRuminant will determine the connectivity between microbiomes from different body sites, their heritability and their influence on the host’s key performance indices (KPIs) of efficiency of production, growth, resistance to disease, methane emissions, carbon footprint and phenotypic resilience to changing environmental conditions. The main outputs of the project will be the creation of an expandable benchmark dataset of ruminant-associated microbes, microbiomes and methods for analysis that will be used for answering essential (who, what, where and when) scientific questions and will be the knowledge foundation for innovation.

In conventional production systems, the same strategies support stronger gut health and optimized production performance.

Different challenges. Different mechanisms. One integrated approach to gut health.

Growing herd sizes and labor shortages make continuous, manual health monitoring nearly impossible! That is why we developed HerdTek. It continuously measures seven vital parameters directly on the animal, including in-depth cardiovascular parameters such as heart rate, heart rate variability, and respiratory rate.
